orientationAssignment.rule: Within each organ/side/cell_type, sort exact root IDs numerically; assign pi/4,3pi/4,5pi/4,7pi/4 round robin, restarting each group.
orientationAssignment.warning: Arbitrary assignment; no anatomical directional preference is known or inferred.
orientationAssignment.tuningInputs: Only annotated organ/side/type and exact IDs; no graph edges, motor output, reward, or flight behavior.

transductionPrior.status: declared sensitivity prior; not measured receptor physiology
transductionPrior.formula: I_pA = maxCurrentPa * c / (1 + c); c = max(0, signedBending / momentScale)
